identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H6. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, labels, and UI text.

rules: Cards use 'Crystal Glass' effect: bg-slate-900/50, backdrop-blur-md, border-white/10.
Glows: Use localized radial gradients behind key elements (Blue/Amber).
Borders: 1px solid border-white/5 is mandatory for all cards.

marketing.hero: Split screen: Text Left, Interactive/Image Right (bleeding edge).
marketing.features: Bento Grid: Mix of 1x1, 2x1, and 2x2 cells.

dashboard.widgets: Glass containers with sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-lg).

visual_enhancers.gradients: Radial gradients only. No linear full-screen gradients.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) to background if possible.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-blue-600 transition-all shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(37,99,235,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-white/10 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10
buttons.accent: bg-accent text-slate-900 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-bold hover:bg-amber-400

cards.marketing: rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/40 border border-slate-800 backdrop-blur-sm hover:border-blue-500/30 transition-colors

hero_main.usage: Hero section main image or About Us header

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px. Use color-accent for active states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'framer-motion' and '@studio-freight/lenis' (or just 'lenis') for smooth interactions.
Use 'Outfit' font for all headings. Import from Google Fonts.
Use 'Manrope' font for all body text. Import from Google Fonts.
Implement the Theme Toggle but default to DARK mode as per user request.
For the 'Services' section, use a horizontal scroll or a grid with hover effects.
Ensure 'Student Dashboard' has a distinct layout (Sidebar + Header) compared to Marketing pages.
Use the provided image URLs. DO NOT use placeholders.
Contact Info: contact@wisnotech.com | +234 915 354 1297 | No. 7 Forest Guard Street, Uromi, Edo State
Pricing: Web Dev (200k), App Dev (200k), UI/UX (100k).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Use 2x more padding than you think is necessary.
Glassmorphism requires a border to be visible.
Always add hover states to interactive elements.
Respect the 'Mobile First' constraint: Stack grids on mobile.
